topic: Xi'an, China, around 210 BCE: the Terracotta Army of about 8,000 clay soldiers, each with a different face, discovered by farmers in 1974.

episode.title: Tiny Time Traveler: The Terracotta Hide-and-Seek

shots.narration: A sparkle jump—and a sea of clay faces!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated adventure-film look, sunlit earthen setting in ancient Xi'an, rows of unarmed terracotta statues, no writing.
shots.action: Zoya and Tock materialize in swirling dust and golden sparkles.
shots.mood: Brilliant blue watch glow, warm sunlight, welcoming wonder.

shots.narration: We're in Xi'an, China, around 210 BCE.
shots.scene: Ancient Xi'an, earthy passage between rows of clay soldier statues without weapons, vertical frame.
shots.action: Zoya turns toward the long rows of statues.
shots.mood: Golden light, rich clay textures, curious exploration.

shots.narration: [surprised] The Terracotta Army has about 8,000 clay soldiers!
shots.scene: Tall vertical view across densely arranged unarmed terracotta statues in an earthen setting.
shots.action: Tock stretches upward on his tiny legs beside Zoya.

shots.narration: And each soldier has a different face.
shots.scene: Close view of neighboring terracotta faces with visibly different brows, cheeks, and hairstyles, no weapons.
shots.action: Zoya points from one clay face to another.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight reveals carefully modeled facial details.

shots.scene: Ground-level gap beside broad clay statue feet on dusty earth.
shots.action: Tock steps behind a clay statue's foot.

shots.scene: Narrow passage among tall unarmed terracotta statues, empty dusty ground beside Zoya.

shots.narration: So many faces, but no round glass face!
shots.scene: Clay faces above Zoya, with varied expressions and hairstyles filling the vertical frame.
shots.action: Zoya scans the row of statue faces.

shots.narration: There! A spring behind those clay feet!
shots.scene: Dusty passage, statue feet in foreground, Tock partly concealed with his brass spring tail visible.
shots.action: Zoya crouches beside Tock's hiding place.

shots.scene: Open patch of earth beside the terracotta row, Zoya crouched near a clay foot.
shots.action: Tock steps out from behind the statue.
shots.mood: Cheerful reunion, brass gleaming against warm clay.

shots.narration: Farmers will discover this army in 1974.
shots.scene: Zoya and Tock beside a sweeping row of unarmed terracotta statues, no writing or symbols.
shots.action: Zoya gestures toward the clay army.

shots.narration: Let's leave every clay soldier just as we found it.
shots.scene: Clear earthen passage beside untouched terracotta statues, Zoya's blue wristwatch prominent.
shots.action: Zoya taps her glowing blue wristwatch.

shots.scene: Ancient Xi'an fading behind a bright blue time-travel glow, golden dust filling the vertical frame.
shots.action: Tock bounces into the swirling time-jump sparkles beside Zoya.
shots.mood: Joyful anticipation, luminous blue and gold.

episode.endHook: The blue watch sparkles again—where will their next adventure begin?
episode.description: Zoya and Tock visit Xi'an, China, around 210 BCE and explore the Terracotta Army. Discover about 8,000 clay soldiers, their different faces, and the farmers who discovered them in 1974.
